generic_ballot.source_label: PollingForecast-compatible merged poll archive (RCP plus existing poll inputs)
generic_ballot.display_type: polling average, not an election-day forecast

external_poll.status: public context only; not included in the district forecast

generic_ballot.margin_definition: D/R two-party margin, 100 * (D share - R share) / (D share + R share). RCP uses margin_two_party_pp; existing PollingForecast rows use the PF-compatible margin field. adjusted_margin is not used.
generic_ballot.timing_rule: Include fieldwork ending on/before the report cutoff unless a verified first_public_date is after the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are included with that limitation; archive_ingestion_date is never treated as first-public evidence.

House.method: House seat outlook uses 435 district win probabilities in an independent-race Poisson-binomial distribution. The 14 single-party candidate-field display adjustments do not change this separate aggregate distribution.

Senate.coverage_note: Full-chamber outlook: 35 forecast races plus 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

Governor.coverage_note: Covers all 36 Governor races; poll and fallback composition is recorded in the local source audit.

senate_seat_distribution.interpretation: Approximate Senate seat range from 35 race probabilities and 65 fixed seats; not a party-control probability.

summary.seat_range_note: House and Governor seat ranges aggregate the published race probabilities under an independent-race assumption. Senate includes 65 fixed seats (34 Democratic-caucus and 31 Republican).

governor_seat_distribution.interpretation: Range of Democratic wins across 36 Governor races under an independent-race assumption; this is a race-count range, not a party-control probability.

generic_ballot_forecast.target: National Democratic-minus-Republican House two-party popular-vote margin in percentage points

historical_performance.validation_explanation: The 2018–2024 panel informed forecast selection and is reported as validation. Across all 1,598 House races in that panel, margin MAE is 4.016 pp, Brier score is 0.028705, log loss is 0.095917, and winner-call accuracy is 96.18%. There were 61 hard-call misses. Annual absolute covered-seat errors were 11 (2018), 10 (2020), 1 (2022), and 1 (2024), for 23 total. The full-House actual is shown separately as context; covered-race metrics use only the listed validation races.
historical_performance.governor_calibration_explanation: Governor win probabilities use a proprietary probability calibration. The 2018-2024 cycles informed selection for both incumbent and challenger; the paired scorecard is validation evidence, not an independent holdout.

metadata.description: Race-level historical forecast errors from the same chronological validation streams used in the public performance section.
metadata.error_source: The published House, Senate, and Governor validation forecast rows, using the best currently selected website forecast stream for each office.
metadata.error_definition: Signed error is predicted Democratic-minus-Republican margin minus actual Democratic-minus-Republican margin. Positive means the forecast was too Democratic; negative means it was too Republican.
metadata.summary_aggregation: For a current race label, pool only its eligible 2018–2024 validation rows; the summary MAE uses those same row errors.
metadata.chronology_note: Website prior-error calculations include only 2018, 2020, 2022, and 2024 evaluation rows. Every included row has training_latest_cycle earlier than its evaluation year.
metadata.selection_note: Office streams were selected using the established 2018–2024 validation panel. These historical rows are chronological out-of-time predictions, but the selected stream is not an untouched post-selection test.

House.prediction_source: candidate chronological OOF rows; paired historical values retained after metric and row parity checks

Senate.prediction_source: candidate chronological OOF rows; paired historical values retained after metric and row parity checks

Governor.prediction_source: candidate chronological OOF rows; paired historical values retained after metric and row parity checks

race_page_current_poll_source.timing_rule: Include poll measurements whose fieldwork ends on or before 2026-10-23, unless a verified first_public_date is later than the cutoff. Unknown first-public dates remain unknown and are included; archive ingestion is never treated as first-public evidence. These inputs do not establish that every included poll was publicly available by the cutoff.

CA-34.history_note: This district had no eligible two-party historical target; displayed errors are California peer averages, not CA-34 results.

house_party_only_treatment.rule: When every candidate listed for a 2026 House race belongs to the same major party, assign that party a 100% seat win chance and exclude the race from 2026 accuracy scoring.

forecast_release_note: October 25 update: 2026 House forecasts and current poll summaries include four Pennsylvania district polls first published October 25. The 14 House fields with candidates from only one major party remain excluded from 2026 accuracy scoring; their candidate-field probabilities do not alter the separate aggregate House seat distribution.
